scenarios.description: Tag --contains ref query vs git for-each-ref (no commit-graph)
scenarios.grit_failure: Exact shared walk without commit-graph is dominated by packed commit parent reads on git-git (~208s vs git ~6.4s). Prior baseline used unsound date pruning. Bitset/active-tip optimizations applied; commit-graph path meets target.

scenarios.description: Tag --contains ref query vs git for-each-ref (commit-graph)
Branch --merged ref query vs git for-each-ref on 100k packed refs
scenarios.grit_failure: Does not meet 1.5x target; dominated by listing 100k packed heads in grit-lib before merge filter (git integrates filter in for-each-ref). Peel memoization and unique-tip merge walk applied.
